body.p: There lived a man with his sons. He set bow traos, he caught hares ahead for the winter. Once in the evening he set a bow trap on an old trace of a hare. In the morning he went to check it. [GVY:] tará»ËÅá» -- should be tará»ËÅmá»? He is going and thinking: "Whether [a hare] got caught or not?" He came there and saw the triggered bow trap. There the man was happy. He reached the bow trap, he saw [that] the hare had run off bleeding. He took up the chase; he was following and following it, he saw [that] the hare was crawling under a willow. The man crawled along the hare's trace. He went down in the form. The man went down, he didn't reach the ground, he went on. Going he saw an old path. "Let me go and have a look, what's up there", he thought and went off. When going he saw a yurt; he went in, there are people living. [DCh]: A "balagan" is a yurt with rectangular base, being more He asked: "How do you live?" They said: "Why does the fire spacious than a conical tent. crackle?" The man asked again, those ones said: "Why does the fire crackle?" The man took meat from the table and ate it. They said: "Why does the meat run short?" While it was going on(?), it became night. The man, who [DCh]: The first clause is not entirely clear. had come, lay down with a person, that one screamed out. His relatives got up and said: "He was tickled, call the shaman". In this night they didn't sleep. In the morning they brought the shaman, that one shamanized, he saw nothing. They called a higher shaman, that one didn't see anything either. The ill one got worse. For the third time s/he(?) called the highest shaman. That one saw the human without going in. The shaman said: "There he is". The shaman asked the man: "Where did you come from?" The man said: "I came from up there following a hare. In the morning I went to check my bow trap, it was triggered. The hare had run away bleeding. I followed it. It crawled under a willow, I [also] crawled there, I went down and went down, I came to a path. So I came here". The shaman fed the man, he sent him back. The man returned, then he hold his relatives how he was walking to the lower world.
